articles.summary: Barchart: Thanks to Trump, Elon Musk’s Prophesy About Chinese EV Companies Might Come True. The EU is considering replacing the tariffs on Chinese electric cars with a “price floor,” while Canada is reportedly looking to ease the tariffs. As trade barriers are lowered, could Chinese EV companies demolish other companies, as Elon Musk prophesied? Related tickers mentioned: TSLA.
